content.what_it_is: Commented (tutorial) MATLAB version of the tohoku_tsunami surface snapshot plot for FUNWAVE-TVD postprocessing. User-input section (L4-L22): output directory fdir (L9), depth file directory depth_file_dir=fdir (L12), snapshot numbers nfile=[2 9] (L15), and hour labels time={'1' '8'} (L18). It loads depth_30min.txt from depth_file_dir (L26), derives [n,m] (L27), builds 0.5-degree lon/lat coordinates with origins 132.01667/-59.98333 (L30-L33), and sets a 5x7-inch figure (L37-L40). Per snapshot (L43-L78): zero-pads the number (L47), loads eta_<fnum> (L50), NaNs land where dep<0 (L53), plots pcolor(x,y,eta) with flat shading in stacked subplots (L56-L59), titles ' Time = <time> hr ' (L61), applies caxis [-0.5 0.5] for the first panel else [-0.05 0.05] (L65-L69), labels Lat/Lon, adds an eta (m) colorbar and zbuffer renderer (L71-L76). Differences from plot_surface.m: depth is loaded from the user-set directory instead of the repo-relative path, and the dead caxis([-0.1 0.1]) line is removed.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
depth_file_dir — depth file directory, equal to fdir (L12)
eta — surface elevation per snapshot, land NaN-ed (L50, L53)

equations.ref: masking land cells (negative depth) before plotting

io.name: stacked pcolor panels of eta at 1 hr and 8 hr with colorbars

unresolved: Snapshot-to-hour mapping [2 9] -> {'1' '8'} implies a 3600 s output interval; must match the case input, not verifiable here.

This version expects depth_30min.txt inside the run output directory (L12, L26), unlike plot_surface.m which reads it from ../external_files/; the user must copy the depth file for this script to work.
The variable name time (L18) shadows MATLAB's built-in time-related identifiers only cosmetically, but overwriting it is a common tutorial hazard; no functional impact inside this script.
